SCHWEINFURT-REGENSBURG · 17 AUGUST 1943

Two forces were meant to split the German defences: the Regensburg force would fly on to North Africa and the Schweinfurt force would follow close behind. Fog in England held the second force back for hours, so the fighters could meet each force in turn.

Escort: No escort past the border · Airmen lost: about 550 · Luftwaffe fighters lost: about 27

REGENSBURG FORCE
SCHWEINFURT FORCE

Target: Ball-bearing plants, Schweinfurt

FLY THIS RAID

sr.report:
HISTORICAL RAID · SCHWEINFURT-REGENSBURG
AS IN HISTORY

Your group paid about what the real raid paid. That is how close to the edge these missions were. A new best for this raid.

	YOUR GROUP	HISTORY, SCALED TO 12 SHIPS	HISTORY, THE WHOLE RAID
BOMBERS LOST	2/12	1.9/12	60/376
LOSS RATE	17%	16%
FIGHTERS DOWNED	0	0.9	about 27
YOUR SHIP	Came home

What really happened: Both targets were hit hard. The Messerschmitt plant at Regensburg lost weeks of output, and Schweinfurt's bearing production fell by about a third for a time. One Fortress in six did not come back.

The bomber gunners claimed 288 fighters that day; the Luftwaffe actually lost about 27.

bt.report:
HISTORICAL RAID · BLACK THURSDAY
BETTER THAN HISTORY

Your group came home with fewer losses than the real raid. The men who flew it that day would have given a lot for that. A new best for this raid.

	YOUR GROUP	HISTORY, SCALED TO 12 SHIPS	HISTORY, THE WHOLE RAID
BOMBERS LOST	0/12	2.5/12	60/291
LOSS RATE	0.0%	21%
FIGHTERS DOWNED	0	1.6	about 38
YOUR SHIP	Came home

What really happened: The bearing plants were badly damaged, but Germany dispersed production and drew on its stocks. The losses were too high to repeat: deep raids beyond escort range stopped until the long-range fighters came.

A further 17 bombers were wrecked on return and never flew again.

The bomber gunners claimed 186 fighters that day; the Luftwaffe actually lost about 38.

غارة تاريخية · برلين
أسوأ من التاريخ

خسرت مجموعتك أكثر مما خسرته الغارة الحقيقية. شدّ التشكيل وأعلن عن المقاتلات مبكراً، ثم نفّذها مجدداً. أفضل نتيجة جديدة لهذه الغارة.

	مجموعتك	التاريخ، بمقياس 12 قاذفة	التاريخ، الغارة كاملة
القاذفات المفقودة	3/12	1.1/12	69/730
نسبة الخسائر	25%	9.5%
المقاتلات المُسقطة	0	1.1	نحو 66
طائرتك	عادت إلى القاعدة

ما حدث فعلاً: شتّتت الغيوم القصف فلم تُمسّ الأهداف الرئيسية إلا قليلاً. لكن اللوفتفافه صعدت للدفاع عن عاصمتها وتكبدت خسائر فادحة، وبعد يومين عادت القوة الثامنة فوق برلين.

ادّعى مدفعيو القاذفات إسقاط 97 مقاتلة ذلك اليوم، بينما خسرت اللوفتفافه فعلياً نحو 66.
